title: The Harlem Globetrotters: Rivalry Tour
seo_title: Harlem Globetrotters Rivalry Tour in Springfield, MO
description: The Harlem Globetrotters bring their Rivalry Tour to the court, with the Washington Generals and a new lineup of rivals, and fans can help decide plays, get pulled onto the court, and take over the jumbotron. A free pre-game tip-off party starts when doors open, and the event is aimed at families and fans of all ages. It takes place Tuesday, March 16, 2027 at 7:00 PM at Great Southern Bank Arena, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO, with doors at 6:00 PM and parking available for $20 or $50 premium.
